decisions: CodeGraph CLI init --yes can install Git hooks; the adapter uses the official SDK in a fresh staging directory, with telemetry/daemon/download fallback disabled, then atomically promotes only a complete index.

OpenWiki begin(init) writes AGENTS.md, optional CLAUDE.md and a scheduled workflow and can replace an existing wiki. It runs in an isolated disposable repository; only the native openwiki state is promoted into a fresh empty project target. Root setup/configuration is never overwritten.

OpenWiki initialization is a valid durable planning run, not a completed generated wiki. Codex resumes the same native run; source drift triggers upstream replanning. No Claims, run state, or database contents are invented or edited by Rigup.
Only exact pinned project installations may initialize; external binaries may still be registered without initialization.
